items.title: Cultural inquiry and complexity
items.description: Workshops and interviews to investigate how everyday behaviour, values, and power shape organisational culture.

items.title: Coaching entrepreneurs using VSM and systems patterns
items.description: Using the Viable System Model and Patterns of Strategy with founders to examine roles, coordination, and strategic choices.

items.title: Embedding systems thinking into service transformation
items.description: Regional Transformation Academies bringing systemic inquiry into Lean, Agile, and public-service improvement work.

items.title: Using conversation mapping to surface undiscussables
items.description: A county council example of using conversation maps and the Ladder of Inference to investigate avoided issues and defensive habits.

items.title: Organisation design for an island government
items.description: A wider account of work on Guernsey's government, including VSM diagnosis, commissioning, and experiential work on organisational cultures.

items.title: Place-based systems work with Save the Children
items.description: Boundary questions and mapping used with Save the Children UK to examine local support for children and families.

items.title: Systems leadership in Peterborough and Cambridgeshire
items.description: Health, care, and council leaders working on shared problems through action learning, systems mapping, and reflection.

items.title: Organisation design for States of Guernsey
items.description: An account of early VSM and organisation-design work in Guernsey. This overlaps with the later island-government account above.
